sentences.en: Gibbons are the smallest tailless monkeys. They are excellent acrobats.
sentences.zh: 鼯猴是体型最小的无尾猴。它们是出色的杂技演员。

sentences.en: You can download our publications in Acrobat Portable Document Format.
sentences.zh: 你可以下载我们的出版物，格式为Acrobat便携文档格式。

sentences.en: To be an acrobat is the ambition of almost every boy.
sentences.zh: 成为杂技演员几乎是每个男孩的梦想。

senses.zh: 杂技演员，特技演员；随机应变者；翻云覆雨者，善变者
